reference_policy: All and only supplied public images; text briefs have no target image. Invisible private surfaces are not targets.
focus: Visual requirement diagnostic. Exact numerical requirements need native measurement; never infer numerical compliance from perspective images. Do not add physics or hidden shape requirements.

checks.question: 整体主体身份、轮廓、体量比例和布局；只看几何形状与相对关系，不能用配色代替。
units: Every applicable visible requirement in instruction.md
checks.coverage_definition: Fraction of distinct required visible features actually implemented, with concrete per-feature observations. Missing features lower coverage once.
checks.deviation_definition: Geometric/appearance deviation only within implemented features; at zero coverage use zero deviation. No score bins, caps or whole-task multiplier.
